BPSC 72nd PT Exam Postponed Due to Unforeseen Reasons

The Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has postponed the 72nd Combined Competitive Preliminary Examination, originally scheduled for October 25, 2026. The commission cited unavoidable reasons for the postponement and stated that new dates will be announced soon. Candidates preparing for the exam are advised to monitor the official website for updates.
